country:YEM.headline: Falling by 2.1 % per decade
country:YEM.detail: Significant. If nothing were really changing, a pattern this strong would turn up by chance less than 1 time in 100. The total change since 2001 is larger than the usual year-to-year swing (2.4 times it), so the region is far outside its normal range.

country:ZMB.headline: No significant trend (down 3.5 % per decade, but it could be chance)
country:ZMB.detail: Not significant. If nothing were really changing, a pattern this strong would turn up by chance about 1 time in 4. A trend can be real and still too small to see through the noise: at this rate, about 4 more years of data would settle it.
